credits.title: Super Santa: Cold Pursuit
credits.overview: Super Santa must face a government conspiracy to eliminate all Santa's worldwide. But being unprepared can he really defeat the force trying to end Christmas? One thing is for sure in this sequel to the 2025 hit film "Super Santa Clause" good Kids will get presents, bad kids coal and Criminals get... a second hole!

credits.title: Super Santa Clause
credits.overview: Super Santa Clause is no regular Saint Nick. When his bag of presents is stolen, he handles the problem himself. A 5 minute action comedy shot in the rough edged style of late Soviet and post Soviet cinema.
